author: CC
prose: Audit of cairn/devices/**/proofs on akienasus, 2026-11-13 (the orchestrator's release; codemother and tester excluded; Windows, harbor_master and LF tickets avoided): 81 candidate proofs grepped for ~/.cairn berths and the bus, run by bin/cairn test: 74 green, 6 red, 1 timeout. Shapes. (S1) sole path: test_host.py, test_the_bus_client_is_admitted_to_the_sole_path.py and the proxy's every_other_proof tooth red on cairn/tools/usage/usage.py importing urllib.request; already held by Q#95 on dd79ed8a1ece. (S2) a chart berth only on the charting box: test_inference_domain_answers_the_bus.py's test_no_orient_packet_since_the_fix_reports_the_tree_stratum_unavailable globs orient packets after 20260907 under ~/.cairn/devices/chart and finds none here. (S3) a foreign program absent: aider_shim test_fence.py and test_translation.py read ~/dev/src/aider, not on akienasus. (S4) a migration measured on one box's db: the proxy proof's live_the_table_is_gone_and_the_meter_carried asserts >= 11366 answer-tree leaves; this box holds 17. (S5) far-box env in a scratch run: recovery's test_a_unit_a_test_run_starts_is_the_runs.py timed out at 120 s; at 600 s test_a_failed_unit_of_a_run_collects_itself reds 'web launched=False' because _drive copies os.environ, so CAIRN_HOME_HOST=akiendelllinux.local makes superclaude skip the web_server; green with CAIRN_HOME_HOST and CAIRN_BUS_HOME unset.
